name: Low-Poly Gradient Mesh
desc: A Delaunay triangulation of gently drifting points whose facets are flat-filled from a domain-warped color field, forming a crystalline low-poly mesh that reads as smooth aurora gradients, leaded stained glass, thermal false-color, a cyan blueprint wireframe, or chalky pastel shards.

density.doc: facet count (more = finer mesh, up to ~130 points)

warp.doc: domain-warp turbulence of the underlying color field
